description: Close an x402 V2 session locally before it expires naturally: this server discards its stored copy of the session token and x402_session_fetch will return an error for the closed session. This is NOT server-side revocation — the signed bearer token cannot be revoked once issued, and any copy already sent to (or intercepted en route to) the remote endpoint remains technically valid there until the expiry baked into the token. If you suspect the token leaked, treat it as live until that expiry and notify the endpoint operator. Still useful hygiene: it stops further use from this process and scrubs the stored token material.
name: x402_session_end
